primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." You're not imagining it — developers are buying up industrial stock across Melbourne's west and squeezing out genuine owner-occupiers. Dozens of small business owners have told us the same story. That's why this Truganina development prioritises owner-occupiers first. Fixed price. No auction. Purpose-built warehouses near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Join the business owners who stopped fighting developers and found a smarter way to buy.
description: Priority access for owner-occupiers ahead of developers and investors
